notes.en: Official Spider Vault v1.5.9 release: dedicated Fingerprint biometric unlock button, full Cosmos SDK v0.50.10 & CometBFT v0.38.12 parity, direct validator staking dispatch, in-vault AMM swaps, seamless external Chrome redirect, and White Card SSO cross-subdomain authorization.
notes.it: Rilascio ufficiale Spider Vault v1.5.9: pulsante sblocco impronta digitale dedicato, parita' Cosmos SDK v0.50.10 e CometBFT v0.38.12, staking validatori diretto, swap AMM in-vault, reindirizzamento Chrome esterno e autorizzazione SSO White Card.
